## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated; `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Docs updated (README, package READMEs, `docs/`) where behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
- [ ] No media files, API keys, `.env` files or `.overtone/` cache committed
- [ ] Style packs: screenshots or a preview image attached
- [ ] Language packs: caption examples included (see [docs/contributing/languages.md](https://github.com/lonthq/overtone-captions/blob/main/docs/contributing/languages.md))
